label: is
definition: This ESCO Occupation can be mapped to the corresponding ECSF role profile as both describe the same cybersecurity role.
caveat: Important note: The relationship between the ESCO occupation and the ECSF role profile does not represent an equivalence; it offers a best fit approximation that readers may wish to investigate.
source_document: ENISA, User Manual: European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF), September 2022 (KB 2/Europe/ENISA European Cybersecurity Skills Framework User Manual.pdf)
